entries.title: Psalms 39:1
segments: ¶<<To the chief Musician, to Jeduthun. A Psalm of David.>> I said, I will take heed to my ways, that I sin not with my tongue: I will keep my mouth with a muzzle, while the wicked is before me.

entries.title: Psalms 39:2
segments: I was dumb with silence, I held my peace from good; and my sorrow was stirred.

entries.title: Psalms 39:3
segments: My heart burned within me; the fire was kindled in my musing: I spoke with my tongue,

entries.title: Psalms 39:4
segments: Make me to know, Jehovah, mine end, and the measure of my days, what it is: I shall know how frail I am.

entries.title: Psalms 39:5
segments: Behold, thou hast made my days [as] hand-breadths, and my lifetime is as nothing before thee; verily, every man, [even] the high placed, is altogether vanity. Selah.

entries.title: Psalms 39:6
segments: Verily, man walketh in a vain show; verily they are disquieted in vain; he heapeth up [riches], and knoweth not who shall gather them.

entries.title: Psalms 39:7
segments: ¶And now, what wait I for, Lord? my hope is in thee.

entries.title: Psalms 39:8
segments: Deliver me from all my transgressions; make me not the reproach of the foolish.

entries.title: Psalms 39:9
segments: I was dumb, I opened not my mouth; for *thou* hast done [it].

entries.title: Psalms 39:10
segments: Remove thy stroke away from me: I am consumed by the blow of thy hand.

entries.title: Psalms 39:11
segments: When thou with rebukes dost correct a man for iniquity, thou makest his beauty to consume away like a moth: surely, every man is vanity. Selah.

entries.title: Psalms 39:12
segments: Hear my prayer, Jehovah, and give ear unto my cry; be not silent at my tears: for I am a stranger with thee, a sojourner, like all my fathers.

entries.title: Psalms 39:13
segments: Look away from me, and let me recover strength, before I go hence and be no more.
